dryRun.description: When true, validate and return result without writing disk.

identity.description: WI7 element identity target. Scopes the edit to the resolved component (path from `identity.file`; ops nodeIds rewritten when the element moved).

ops.description: Atomic batch of structured ops (`insert`/`replace`/`wrap`/`setAttr`/ `removeAttr`/`setSx`/`move`). For full-content write pass `[]` with `writeSource: true` and the complete body in `source` (WI3 check-guard).

path.description: Workspace-relative `.sail` path. Optional when `identity.file` is set (WI7 identity-scoped target).

source.description: Optional inline source (else file is read). With `writeSource: true` and empty `ops`, this is the full file body to check-guard and commit. Combined with dryRun for validate-only.

writeSource.description: Full-content check-guarded write (WI3). When true with empty `ops` and a string `source`, run check on the body; on error diagnostics leave the file byte-identical and return `applied: false`; on success write and return diagnostics for the new state. Prefer over any patch DSL.

identity.description: Resolved live identity when an identity-scoped edit was requested.
